source_name: PaySpace Magazine UA (psm7.com) — fintech/vendor announcement aggregator
why_relevant: Ukrainian payments trade outlet that republishes and expands vendor press releases (e.g. UPC–Tietoevry open-banking platform). Useful as a catch-net for vendor announcements whose own press rooms are not crawled, and it dates them.

source_name: Finance Club UA (finclub.net) — banking/fintech deal news
why_relevant: Ukrainian financial trade outlet covering vendor–bank announcements (UPC open banking, processor and technology partnerships). Complements psm7 and often carries bank-side confirmation of vendor claims.

source_name: Checkbox (checkbox.ua) blog — certified terminal/partner announcements
why_relevant: Ukrainian software-RRO provider whose blog announces which hardware vendors and terminal models have been certified with it (e.g. Printec / Castles S1F2 Android). Certification announcements are an early indicator of a terminal model about to enter bank/merchant deployment.

source_name: PrivatBank self-service terminal pages — deployed device fleet description
why_relevant: Largest Ukrainian bank's public description of its self-service terminal network; combined with vendor claims it lets one attribute the fleet to suppliers. PrivatBank is also unusual in having built devices in-house, which is itself a competitive fact for the supply side.

source_name: ATM Marketplace — global self-service vendor news
why_relevant: Trade outlet covering NCR Atleos / Diebold Nixdorf / Euronet product and deployment news. Useful for tracking global vendor strategy and occasional CEE/Ukraine deployment items that vendors do not localise.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА (EMA) — Члени / Members directory
why_relevant: EMA is the Ukrainian interbank association of payment-system members (banks, PSPs, payment systems, financial companies, MFOs). Its members page enumerates essentially the whole card/payments buyer universe in UA — the master actor list for every other A2 tender-monitoring cell.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА — Партнери (vendor/partner page)
why_relevant: Partner list surfaces the supply side — technology vendors, processors, security and anti-fraud suppliers courting UA banks. Weak signal for who is positioning ahead of tenders.

source_name: НАБУ / Національна (Незалежна) асоціація банків України — Банки-учасники
why_relevant: Member banks of NABU represent the overwhelming majority of Ukrainian banking assets. Canonical enumeration of bank buyers whose procurement (ATMs, cards, software, cash handling) is the A2 target. NOTE: acronym НАБУ is ambiguous with the anti-corruption bureau — noisy term.

source_name: НАБУ — новини/анонси заходів (association news & event announcements)
why_relevant: NABU announces and co-brands industry events; the announcement pages name organisers, sponsors and thematic focus (payment infrastructure, open banking, AI), revealing which modernisation programmes banks are preparing to buy.

source_name: Асоціація українських банків (АУБ / AUB)
why_relevant: Second major banking association (founded 1990, EBF member). Its member roster and Council page (Рада АУБ) name banks plus the individual executives who chair procurement-relevant committees.

source_name: Асоціація «Український кредитно-банківський союз» (УКБС / UCBS)
why_relevant: Third banking association, reported to unite ~92 financial-credit institutions including foreign representative offices — extends the actor map beyond the largest banks into mid-tier and non-bank financial institutions that also run procurement.

source_name: Каталог фінтех-компаній України / Fintech Catalog (UAFIC annual catalogue, PDF)
why_relevant: A structured, downloadable enumeration of Ukrainian fintech companies with segment tags — the single richest one-shot vendor/actor list for the payments supply side. New editions are collected annually (Fintech Catalog 2026 call for entries open).

source_name: UAFIN.TECH conference (UAFIC flagship) — agenda, speakers, partners
why_relevant: Largest annual UA fintech/banking conference. Agenda topics and the sponsor/partner tiers show which vendors are investing to reach bank buyers and which technology themes (AI in financial processes, open banking) banks are budgeting for.

source_name: Pay.Forum (UAFIC payments conference)
why_relevant: Payments-specific forum gathering top bank managers, payment providers, retailers and fintech startups — the agenda is effectively a preview of the payment-infrastructure projects banks intend to procure.

source_name: Fintech & Payments Forum 2026 (IT Ukraine Association events calendar)
why_relevant: B2B forum (Kyiv, ~200 participants from banks, financial institutions, fintech and IT). The IT Ukraine Association events calendar is itself a recurring pointer to banking/payments events and their organisers.

source_name: IT Ukraine Association — FinTech Committee
why_relevant: Committee membership names the IT service companies that build and integrate banking/payment systems in Ukraine — i.e. the likely bidders and subcontractors in bank tenders.

source_name: European Business Association (Ukraine) — Electronic Payments Committee
why_relevant: EBA unites ~970 companies; the Electronic Payments Committee gathers members whose core business is banking and e-payments, and publishes positions/meetings with the NBU. Both an actor list and an early view of regulatory-driven spending.

source_name: Power Payment Summit: Ukraine–Europe Bridge (ProMoney / PSM7 announcement)
why_relevant: Summit agenda (SEPA readiness, instant payments/A2A, card future, open banking, payment security) is a direct read on the infrastructure programmes UA banks and PSPs will fund and tender in the next 12-24 months.

source_name: Ukrainian Fintech Awards
why_relevant: Nomination and shortlist pages enumerate fintech vendors and bank projects by category — a curated map of who has delivered what, useful for anticipating references in future tenders.

source_name: Ukrainian Banking Summit (UAFIC, announced via LinkedIn)
why_relevant: Executive-level banking summit; the announcement and attendee/sponsor communications indicate which bank executives and suppliers are aligning around modernisation programmes. LinkedIn is also the channel where UA banks post procurement/vendor-management roles.

source_name: Work.ua — банківські вакансії із закупівель/тендерів
why_relevant: Job ads for 'фахівець з тендерів', 'менеджер з закупівель', 'тендерний менеджер' at banks and their suppliers expose planned programmes, internal buying structures and categories (ATM channel, cash handling, IT) months before a tender is published. Search results already showed UKRSIBBANK (BNP Paribas) hiring a procurement manager in Kyiv.

source_name: Robota.ua — тендерні та закупівельні вакансії
why_relevant: Second major UA job board; complementary employer coverage to work.ua, including bank and supplier procurement/tender roles.

source_name: Jooble UA — aggregated procurement/tender vacancies
why_relevant: Aggregator across many UA job boards and company career pages — useful as a wide net to discover employers (including banks' suppliers) that do not post on the two main boards.

source_name: DOU.ua — вакансії та календар IT-подій
why_relevant: DOU carries IT vacancies at banks/fintechs (including vendor-management, integration and core-banking roles) and a well-maintained events calendar that lists fintech/banking conferences. Company pages (e.g. UAFIC) double as actor profiles.
